status: FROZEN BEFORE ANY RUN (W0/W1 source author, claude-opus-5-5). Rules, tolerances and falsifiers below are fixed now and must not be altered after observing results. Any result outside them is reported as a falsified model or prediction, never refitted.
quantity: Host CEK execution_units (mem, cpu) printed by `aiken check` v1.1.24+bacbeb3 under its default cost model at --trace-filter all --trace-level silent (the A1 setting). These are NOT ledger ExUnits, NOT the Preprod PlutusV3 cost model and NOT a measurement of the compiled validator wrapper (X1/PX04).
harnessDecodeVsLedger: Stage D is aiken/cbor.deserialise over the fixture ScriptContext plus test_ctx field rebuilding and datum/redeemer downcasts. On chain the ledger passes the context as Data and the compiled wrapper does its own (different) decoding. D is subtracted to approximate validator logic; it is not an estimate of wrapper cost. A ledger-shaped X1 measurement stays a separate future step (PB-03) and must not be replaced by D.

benchShape.rule: Each bench decodes once, builds only the stages in its closure (EXPECTED-COMPONENTS.json), evaluates one subject once, and returns a Bool. No component bench builds diag.settle_facts, a named list or another component.

definitions.bench(x): observed mem (and separately cpu) of test w0_<ctx>_<x>

componentMarginals.rule: k(x) = bench(x) - bench(prefix(x)), where prefix(x) is the stage bench whose closure equals x's closure

additiveModel.statement: bench(gate) = D + B + SD + E + S + C + A + SC + M + ST + N + sum over the 19 components of k(x) + r, where r is the residual.
whyNotExactSum: Shared setup: every component bench repeats D and its stage closure; only marginals (differences) are summed, so shared work counts once.
Cached work: production builds each stage once and passes it to every component that needs it; the model counts each stage marginal once for the same reason.

Strict vs short-circuit: on these POSITIVE contexts every component is True, so the production gate evaluates every stage and every component (no short-circuit saving applies). Internal short-circuits inside a component (and/list.all) are part of k(x) and identical in bench and gate.

Overhead not in any marginal: the gate's if/and chain, Some/list.map of signature checks, stage record construction and field access patterns that differ from the bench helpers, the bench forcing predicates (W0-AUTHOR, a few thousand mem each) and per-test compiler/optimizer differences.

tolerance.perMarginalSanity: every stage and component marginal >= -50000 mem and >= -20000000 cpu

falsifiers: Residual outside tolerance for any context: the additive model is FALSIFIED for that context. Report bench values and r; do not change tolerances, add terms or drop benches afterwards.

A marginal below the sanity floor: the bench shape is INVALID for that marginal (likely optimizer elimination or reordering); report it as such and exclude it from W2 attribution, without substitution.
Any W0 test failing or halting: its truth expectation (EXPECTED-COMPONENTS.json) is FAILED; no cost from that test is used.

derivedReports.logicExcludingHarnessDecode: bench(gate) - D per context (host CEK; still includes no wrapper decode and no signature verification).
derivedReports.p07TwoThreadHostEstimate: (bench(gate,P07.0) - D(P07.0)) + (bench(gate,P07.1) - D(P07.1)), labelled a host estimate of S2 logic for one atomic two-thread transaction without signatures, wrapper decode or the C2 release; not a ledger figure.
derivedReports.shares: Each stage marginal and component marginal as a fraction of bench(gate) - D, per context.
derivedReports.diagOverhead: bench(diag_gate) - bench(gate): cost of named labels, the parts list, the facts record and evaluating all components without the gate's ordering.

readings: W2 (typed-intent digest) is supported only if SC + M is the largest share of bench(gate) - D in at least P01 and P04.

W2b (move recomputation into the proved relation) is supported only if E + S + k(recomputed) + k(intent_effects) + k(payouts) + ST outweigh SC + M; it also needs the K2 relation work and a proof that the relation includes exactly those conditions.
W3 (withdraw-zero coordinator) is indicated for P07 if per-thread repeated work (k(global_outputs), C, k(claim), D-independent base work) times thread count is material, independently of W2.
